about.en: WangChai (旺柴) is a BNB Chain memecoin named after the 旺柴 Shiba Inu sticker, one of WeChat's most-used emoji, which the project brands "WeChat's OG Doge" — the Chinese counterpart to Dogecoin. Its site publishes a single BNB Chain token, 0x14F6A94909C407854390Aa2d2462a3095D317777 (18 decimals, 1,000,000,000 supply), traded on PancakeSwap against BNB and USDT. It is a culture and community token, with no protocol, product or revenue behind it.
